shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat AGENTS.md; cat package.json; cat src/types/messages.ts; cat src/index.ts; cat specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md; cat specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/transport/ws/validation.ts; cat src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | rg -n 'spec|anchor' -C 3; cat src/types/messages.ts; cat jest.config.js | head -80"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]' src | head; cat src/infrastructure/stores/sessionStoreListSignature.test.ts; rg -n 'messages|sessionStore' src/index.ts; cat src/types/sessionStore.ts | head -100; git log -1 --oneline"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '85,120p' src/index.ts; rg -n 'spec.*#|@spec' src scripts/lore* | head -30; head -35 CHANGELOG.md; ls scripts/spec-links"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/types/messages.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace('export type IncomingMessage = UserMessagePayload | PingMessage;',\"export interface ListSessionsMessage {\\n  type: 'list_sessions';\\n  limit?: number;\\n  before?: {sessionId: string; updatedAt: string | number};\\n}\\n\\nexport type IncomingMessage = UserMessagePayload | PingMessage | ListSessionsMessage;\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/transport/ws/validation.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"    case 'ping':\\n      return validatePingMessage(message);\", \"    case 'ping':\\n      return validatePingMessage(message);\\n    case 'list_sessions':\\n      return validateListSessions(message);\")
s += '''\\nfunction validateListSessions(message: Record<string, unknown>): ValidationResult {\\n  const {limit, before} = message;\\n  if (limit "'!== undefined && (typeof limit !== '"'number' || "'!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 0)) {'"\\n    return {valid: false, error: 'list_sessions limit must be a non-negative integer'};\\n  }\\n  if (before "'!== undefined) {'"\\n    if (typeof before "'!== '"'object' || before === null) {\\n      return {valid: false, error: 'list_sessions before must be a cursor'};\\n    }\\n    const cursor = before as Record<string, unknown>;\\n    if (typeof cursor.sessionId "'!== '"'string' || cursor.sessionId.length < 1 || cursor.sessionId.length > 128 ||\\n      (typeof cursor.updatedAt "'!== '"'string' && typeof cursor.updatedAt "'!== '"'number') ||\\n      "'!Number.isFinite(new Date(cursor.updatedAt).getTime())) {'"\\n      return {valid: false, error: 'list_sessions before must be a valid cursor'};\\n    }\\n    return {valid: true, data: {type: 'list_sessions', ...(limit === undefined ? {} : {limit}), before: {sessionId: cursor.sessionId, updatedAt: cursor.updatedAt}}};\\n  }\\n  return {valid: true, data: {type: 'list_sessions', ...(limit === undefined ? {} : {limit})}};\\n}\\n'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules timeout 300 npx jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='.lore/dod.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Validate "'`list_sessions` frames'"','- [x] Validate "'`list_sessions` frames'"'); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md'; s=open(p).read(); needle='- The validator accepts an optional non-negative integer'; line=next(x for x in s.splitlines() if x.startswith(needle)); s=s.replace(line,line[:-2]+', [validated by: validates list_sessions pagination and strips unknown fields](../../src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts#L4)).'); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='CHANGELOG.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('### Added\\n','### Added\\n\\n- The WebSocket validator recognizes "'`list_sessions` requests and validates their pagination fields.'"\\n',1); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat; git status --short; cat src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts; tail -45 src/transport/ws/validation.ts; tail -4 specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md; rg -n 'message\\.content|message\\.timestamp|switch \\(.*\\.type' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts src/types/messages.ts && git commit -m 'feat(transport): validate session list requests' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
